description.ja: ガンダムシリーズ最新作『機動戦士ガンダム 水星の魔女』より、ハインドリーが商品化！
description.en: Hindley is commercialized from the latest Gundam series "Mobile Suit Gundam Witch of Mercury"!

description.ja: ■挟み込みを避け、後はめ加工をメインとするパーツ構成により組み立てやすさに配慮。
description.en: • Ease of assembly is taken into account by avoiding pinching and using a parts configuration that requires post-fitting.

description.ja: ■首・腰部のボールジョイントは空間を設けた構造で前後傾の姿勢にも対応。
description.en: • The ball joints in the neck and lower back have a spaced structure that allows for forward and backward leaning postures.

description.ja: ■マッシブなフォルムに加え、回転可動を備えた全高ほどもある長さの専用武器を装備。
description.en: • In addition to its massive form, it is equipped with a special weapon that is as long as its total height and can rotate.

description.ja: ■左腕には専用シールドを保持。シールドは正面に向けられるようにアーム部分が可動。
description.en: • He holds a special Seal on his left arm. The arm part of Seal is movable so that it can be facing forward.

description.ja: ■背部には３本のノズルで構成されたバックパックを装備、高い機動性能を有する。
description.en: • Equipped with a backpack consisting of three nozzles on its back, giving it high maneuverability.

series.name: Mobile Suit Gundam Witch of Mercury
